title: Manifest-Assisted Retrieval in Artificial Intelligence Search: Evidence Gaps and a Security Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38361v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The external sources retained in our non-systematic audit did not isolate the incremental security or utility effect of consuming /llms.txt while ordinary retrieval remained fixed. The initial audit covered 39 sources through August 16, 2026, with later targeted updates through October 14. A purposive 15-tool study observed no automatic requests in 45 trials at one endpoint; a non-probability log study found that 97% of domains with detected files received no recorded requests in May 2026. We separate publication, fetch, model use, and action; define five operational threat paths and paired security-utility estimands; and exercise deterministic pre-model controls with 30 author-defined parser fixtures. We also execute a reduced pilot: 24 tasks across eight sites, five conditions, and 120 real model responses, with ordinary evidence held fixed. translated_title: 人工智能搜索中的清单辅助检索：证据缺口与安全评估
translated_abstract: 我们的非系统性审计所保留的外部来源，并未在普通检索保持固定的情况下，分离出使用 /llms.txt 带来的增量安全或效用影响。初始审计涵盖截至2026年8月16日的39个来源，随后在10月14日前进行了针对性的补充更新。一项针对15个工具的目的性抽样研究，在单一端点的45次试验中未观察到任何自动请求；一项非概率抽样的日志研究则发现，2026年5月检测到该文件的域名中有97%未收到任何被记录的请求。我们将发布、抓取、模型使用与行动四个环节加以分离；定义了五条操作性威胁路径以及成对的安全-效用估计量；并通过30个作者定义的解析器测试用例执行了确定性的模型前控制。我们还执行了一个缩减规模的试点实验：在8个站点、5种条件下开展24项任务，共获得120份真实模型响应，同时保持普通证据固定不变。冻结的自动评分在24个原始对抗性响应中的21个里识别出攻击者-目标的采纳情况。
tldr: 本文通过对39个来源的审计、15个工具的实测、日志分析及包含120份真实模型响应的试点实验，系统评估了AI搜索中 /llms.txt 清单辅助检索的部署现状与安全风险，定义了五条威胁路径与成对的安全-效用估计量，并指出现有证据不足以分离其增量安全与效用影响。
en_tdlr: This paper audits and empirically evaluates /llms.txt manifest-assisted retrieval in AI search—via tool trials, log analysis, and a pilot with 120 real model responses—defining five threat paths and paired security-utility estimands, while showing current evidence is insufficient to isolate its incremental security or utility effects.
